function: The overflow-y property specifies whether to clip the content, add a scroll bar, or display overflow content of a block-level element, when it overflows at the top and bottom edges.

values.function: The content is not clipped, and it may be rendered outside the content box. This is default
The content is clipped - and no scrolling mechanism is provided
The content is clipped and a scrolling mechanism is provided
Should cause a scrolling mechanism to be provided for overflowing boxes
Sets this property to its default value. Read about initial
Inherits this property from its parent element. Read about inherit
